name: @plec/node
description: Node.js HTTP host and native Plec runtime bindings

scripts.build: yarn clean && yarn build:native && yarn build:js
scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --manifest-path ../../crates/plec-node-bindings/Cargo.toml --profile node-release --output-dir native --js index.js --dts bindings.d.ts --format esm
scripts.build:native:target: napi build --platform --manifest-path ../../crates/plec-node-bindings/Cargo.toml --profile node-release --output-dir native --js index.js --dts bindings.d.ts --format esm
scripts.build:native:cross: napi build --platform --cross-compile --manifest-path ../../crates/plec-node-bindings/Cargo.toml --profile node-release --output-dir native --js index.js --dts bindings.d.ts --format esm
scripts.build:native:gate: napi build --platform --manifest-path ../../crates/plec-node-bindings/Cargo.toml --profile node-release --features feasibility-gate --output-dir native --js index.js --dts bindings.d.ts --format esm
scripts.test:package: yarn build && yarn package:dirs && yarn package:stage:local && node scripts/test-packed-package.mjs
scripts.test: yarn --cwd ../.. exec vitest run packages/plec-node/src/request-target.test.ts packages/plec-node/src/native-platform.test.ts packages/plec-node/src/static.test.ts packages/plec-node/src/document.test.ts packages/plec-node/src/providers.test.ts packages/plec-node/src/actions.test.ts packages/plec-node/src/api.test.ts packages/plec-node/src/http.test.ts
scripts.test:native: yarn build:native:gate && yarn --cwd ../.. exec vitest run packages/plec-node/src/native-feasibility.test.ts
